bat_pilot.text: Back to Brize Norton? It's a Dash 7 to Punta Arenas and then a long way round. I'll fix the paperwork. Don't forget your hat.

bat_fitter.text: Ten tractors, five skidoos, one digger and a ship's worth of spares: I'm the reason the lights are on. The station runs on diesel and goodwill. Mostly diesel.
Best bit of the job? Midwinter. You haven't lived until you've seen a mechanic in a dinner jacket cut up a goose.

rothera_homebound.text: Heading back to the mainland? Passage to RAF Brize Norton can be arranged whenever you like. Bring your own sandwiches.
